title: Overridden Series On Manual Import fires Imported Webhook Multiple Times
body: ### Is there an existing issue for this? - [x] I have searched the existing open and closed issues ### Current Behavior Series/Episode gets downloaded and flagged as Manual Interaction Required. If Series Name is overridden to the correct series (Auto Detection incorrectly identified series of download) during manual import, the Webhook Fires for both To Detected Series and the Series Selected as the override. 1st Image is Overridden Series, 2nd is Original Detected Series (Both fired back to back) Note: the File is not imported into the detected Series at all, only the overridden series gets the file. it is merely a webhook handling issue. ### Expected Behavior Import Complete Webhook should only fire on the Title Selected as the Override after the import completes. ### Steps To Reproduce Unable to reproduce on demand. I cannot force a download into the manual interaction required state. ### Environment ```markdown - OS: Debian 13 LXC Container - Sonarr: 4.0.20.3012 - Docker Install: No - Using Reverse Proxy: No - Browser: Brave 1.96.61 (Official Build) (64-bit) - Database: Sqlite 3.46.1 ``` ### What branch are you running? Main ### Trace Logs Unable to reproduce on demand. not sure how to guarantee capture of trace log as I cannot force a download into the manual interaction required state. If there is a way to force it into manual interaction required state, please provide instructions and a trace log will be collected. ### Anything else _No response_
author: brad-charboneau
